image_description: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a silver-colored home audio system. The central unit features a digital display at the top, a row of control knobs/buttons, and two large speaker drivers covered by mesh grilles at the bottom. Flanking this central unit are partial views of matching satellite speakers or tower components.
